Occurrences.Kwic: 鞴費分疎。爭如棒下無生忍。聞見馨香滿道塗。舉。雲門問僧云古佛與露柱相交。是第幾機。僧無語。門云。爾問我與爾道。僧遂問。門云。一條縚三十文。僧云。如何是一條縚三十文。門云。打與。代前語云。南山起雲北山下雨。油然南山雲。霈然北山雨。露柱笑呵呵。燈籠超佛祖。中涌邊沒西天東土。樓閣門開竟日閑。野老不知何處去。圓悟佛果禪師語錄卷第十八圓悟佛果禪師語錄卷第十九宋平江府虎丘山門人紹隆等編頌古下頌古下舉。教中道。未離兜率已降王宮。未出母胎度人已畢。大象本無形。至虛包萬有。末後已太過。面南看北斗。王宮兜率度生出胎。始終一貫初無去來。掃蹤滅跡除根蔕。火裏蓮華處處開。舉。僧問雲門。生死到來如何回避。門云。在什麼處。針眼魚吞大千界。蟭螟蟲吐妙高山。太虛包括無遺漏。萬彙全歸指掌間。起復滅去還來。石橋踏斷通身黑。那知華頂是天台。舉。丹霞初見馬祖。以兩手托幞頭祖云。吾非汝師。南嶽石頭處去。霞遂至石頭。如前托幞頭。頭云。著槽𣚿去。霞依童行次。一日石頭為眾云。今日齋後普請剗佛殿前草。眾競具鋤鍬。霞獨洗頭。棒剃刀於石頭前胡跪。頭云作什麼。霞云。請師剗草。石頭笑為剃髮。呼與授戒。霞掩耳而去。却回江西馬祖院。騎聖僧項。眾驚報馬祖。馬祖親來見乃云。我子天然。霞遂作禮云。謝師

Gaofeng Yuanmiao owns the retained deployment: his hall address, opening with the West-Peak self-reference, says that today he will apply one stratagem to sweep away the tracks and erase the traces for everyone, then after a long silence gives the single word: swift.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1405.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shixi Xinyue. Shixi Xinyue owns the retained deployment: his summer-session small meeting at Huqiu's Yanyan temple says the reed-stalk crossing north knew it swallowed its groans, while the single shoe returning west never yet swept away the tracks and erased the traces.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1403.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianru Weize. Tianru Weize owns the retained deployment: after the exchange his hall address says the Vairocana dharma-body hides within a single pore while Samantabhadra's vow-ocean scatters over the tips of a hundred grasses, and there at the grass-tips it is after all sweeping away the tracks and erasing the traces.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (L/L154/L154n1638.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueqiao (juans 7-10), preserving Hanshan Deqing's inscription. Hanshan Deqing owns the exact utterance preserved in Xueqiao Yuanxin's record: his inscription on Xueqiao's portrait says that having won back one life he flung it east and west off to Double Path Peak, not knowing how to sweep away the tracks and erase the traces, letting this visage show - grit in the eye.
